title: A continuous map from a profinite group to a discrete space is invariant under an open normal subgroup
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group and let $S$ be a discrete topological space. If $f:G\to S$ is continuous, then there is an open normal subgroup $U\subseteq G$ such that $f(xu)=f(x)$ for all $x\in G$ and $u\in U$.
